summary: Executed backend pytest suite and frontend Playwright integration smoke. Backend APIs passed after restarting supervisor services; frontend integration is blocked by API path mismatch causing runtime error overlay.

minor.issue: Initial test run returned 502 because backend/frontend supervisor processes were FATAL and required restart.

ui_bugs.issue: React runtime error overlay blocks interactions after initial API calls fail.
IT/EN toggle did not reflect expected translated title during run (likely impacted by runtime error state).

integration_issues.issue: Frontend requests hit /api/api/* and return 404. Example failing paths: /api/api/modes, /api/api/documents, /api/api/system/status.

action_items: Fix frontend API URL construction: avoid double '/api' prefix (baseURL in env is already '/api').
Add frontend API error handling to prevent uncaught runtime overlay from blocking UI navigation.
Re-verify language toggle and all routed pages after integration fix.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/services/api.js currently combines baseURL '/api' with endpoint strings already starting '/api', producing '/api/api/*' 404s in preview.
App-level data fetches in frontend/src/App.js are not guarded by try/catch; unhandled Axios rejections surface as blocking runtime overlay.
Backend mock APIs are functional, but frontend cannot consume them until URL composition is corrected.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded TEST_contract_alpha.pdf via API test and TEST_upload_contract.pdf via UI simulation attempt.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs are passing via public preview endpoint after supervisor restart. Frontend currently fails due to /api/api path issue; start retest from dashboard load and then rerun upload/indexing/chat/viewer flows once api.js URL composition is fixed.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open preview URL, dashboard loads then uncaught Axios errors appear; console shows 404 on /api/api/modes, /api/api/documents, /api/api/system/status. Root cause: frontend API client uses baseURL from .env as '/api' while each request also prepends '/api'. Mitigation: keep '/api' only once (either in baseURL or endpoint paths), then retest full UI routes and interactions. MOCKED backend flows present: /api/indexing/status progression, /api/chat/query demo answer, /api/viewer/{id}/page/{n} demo highlights.
